missions.name: Address Delays
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any Imperial system. Place units on the build queue using this system's resource icons and number.

missions.name: Capture Rebel Operative
missions.rulesText: Attempt against a Rebel leader that is in a system that contains an Imperial unit. If successful, capture that leader.

missions.name: Carbon Freezing
missions.rulesText: Attempt against a captured leader. If successful, attach the Carbonite ring to that leader, and the Rebel player loses 1 reputation. This leader is considered captured. When rescued, discard this attachment ring.

missions.name: Collect Bounty
missions.rulesText: Attempt against a Rebel leader that is in any system. If successful, capture that leader. Then move both that leader and this leader to the closest system that contains an Imperial unit.

missions.name: Construct Death Star
missions.rulesText: Resolve in a remote system that does not contain a Rebel unit. Gain 1 Death Star Under Construction in this system and place 1 Death Star on space 3 of the build queue. When the Death Star is deployed, it replaces the Death Star Under Construction.

missions.name: Construct Factory
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any Imperial system. Place units on the build queue using this system's resource icons and number. If there is a sabotage marker in this system, remove the marker before resolving this ability.

missions.name: Construct Super Star Destroyer
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any Imperial system that has a blue square resource icon. Place 1 Super Star Destroyer on space 3 of the build queue.

missions.name: Detained
missions.rulesText: Attempt against a Rebel leader that is in any system. If successful, that leader does not return to the leader pool during the next refresh phase.

missions.name: Display Of Power
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any populous system. If successful, gain 2 loyalty in this system.

missions.name: Double Our Efforts
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any Imperial system. Choose 1 unit on space 2 or 3 of the build queue and move it down 1 space. If Moff Jerjerrod resolves this mission, you can choose 1 additional unit.

missions.name: Fear Will Keep Them In Line
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system that contains a Death Star, Star Destroyer or Super Star Destroyer. If successful, gain 1 loyalty in 2 systems in this region.

missions.name: Gather Intel
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any Rebel system. If successful, draw 1 probe card for every 4 Rebel units at the Rebel base (minimum of 1 card).

missions.name: Homing Beacon
missions.rulesText: Attempt against a captured leader. If successful, this leader is rescued. The Rebel player must place this leader in any system in the Rebel base's region.

missions.name: Hunt Them Down
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system. If successful, destroy up to 2-health worth of units of your choice in the system.

missions.name: Imperial Propaganda
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any Imperial system. If successful, each system in this region that has Rebel loyalty becomes neutral.

missions.name: Intercept Transmissions
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any Rebel system. If successful, the Rebel player draws 8 cards from the probe deck. He gives you all cards belonging to systems that contain an Imperial unit. Then he shuffles the other cards back into the deck.

missions.name: Interrogation
missions.rulesText: Attempt against a captured leader. If successful, the Rebel player must reveal his hand of objective cards.

missions.name: Interrogation Droid
missions.rulesText: Attempt against a captured leader. Count all skill icons during this attempt. If successful, the Rebel player must name 3 systems. One of these systems must contain the Rebel base.

missions.name: Long Range Probe
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system. If successful, the Rebel player must tell you if the Rebel base is in this system.

missions.name: Lure Of The Dark Side
missions.rulesText: Attempt against a captured leader. Count all skill icons during this attempt. If successful, attach the Lure of the Dark Side ring to the Rebel leader. It becomes an Imperial leader for the rest of the game. If successful against Luke Skywalker, the Rebel player loses 1 reputation.

missions.name: Oversee Project
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any system that contains an Imperial unit and no Rebel units. Choose 1 Imperial unit on space 1 or 2 of the build queue and deploy it in this system.

missions.name: Planetary Conquest
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system. If successful, move up to 1 AT-AT, 1 AT-ST and 2 Stormtroopers from any one system to this system, ignoring transport restrictions and adjacency. If there are Rebel ground units in this system, resolve a combat.

missions.name: Probe Droid Initiative
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any system that contains a Star Destroyer or Super Star Destroyer. Draw 2 cards from the probe deck. If Admiral Ozzel resolves this mission, draw 2 additional cards.

missions.name: Research And Development
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any system that has Imperial loyalty. Choose one of the following: Draw 2 project cards. Choose 1 to keep and place the other on the bottom of the deck. Remove a sabotage marker from this system and draw 1 project card.

missions.name: Retrieve The Plans
missions.rulesText: Attempt against a captured leader. If successful, the Rebel player must reveal his hand of objective cards. Choose 1 of these cards to place on the bottom of the objective deck.

missions.name: Rule By Fear
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any populous system that contains an Imperial unit. If successful, gain 1 loyalty in this system.

missions.name: Secret Weapons Research
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any Imperial system. Draw 2 project cards.

missions.name: Superlaser Online
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any system that contains a Death Star. Destroy this system and gain 1 loyalty in 1 populous system in this region.

missions.name: Trade Negotiations
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any populous system. If successful, gain 1 loyalty in this system.

missions.name: Base Defenses
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any Rebel system. If successful, gain 1 Ion Cannon and 1 Shield Generator in the "Rebel Base" space.

missions.name: Build Alliance
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any populous system. If there are Rebel units in this system, roll 2 additional dice. If successful, gain 1 loyalty in this system.

missions.name: Contingency Plan
missions.rulesText: Assign this leader to a starting mission from your hand, even one that was already attempted or resolved this round. If Lando Calrissian was assigned to this mission, he gains 2 additional successes when he attempts a mission later this round.

missions.name: Covert Operation
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system that contains Imperial units. If successful, draw 2 objective cards. Keep 1 and place the other on the bottom of the deck.

missions.name: Daring Rescue
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system that contains a captured leader. If successful, rescue that leader.

missions.name: Demolition
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any Imperial system. If successful, for each of this system's resource icons destroy 1 unit on the build queue that matches the icon.

missions.name: Establish Trade Relations
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system that does not contain a sabotage marker. If successful, gain 1 loyalty in the system and place units on the build queue using this system's resource icons and number.

missions.name: For The Greater Good
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system that contains a captured leader. If successful, rescue that leader and draw 1 objective card. The leader(s) assigned to this mission remain in this system.

missions.name: Hidden Fleet
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any system that does not contain an Imperial unit. Move units from the "Rebel Base" space to this system as if they were adjacent. Leaders in the "Rebel Base" space do not prevent this movement.

missions.name: Hit And Run
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system. If successful, destroy up to 2-health worth of units of your choice in this system.

missions.name: Ignite Rebellion
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any subjugated system. If successful, gain 3 Rebel Troopers in this system. Then resolve a combat.

missions.name: Infiltration
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system that contains an Imperial unit. If successful, look at the top 2 cards of the objective deck. Place 1 card on the top of the deck and the other card on the bottom.

missions.name: Lead The Strike Team
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system. If successful, move up to 4 ground units from the "Rebel Base" space to this system, ignoring transport restriction and adjacency. If there are Imperial ground units in this system, resolve a combat.

missions.name: Misdirection
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system that contains an Imperial unit. If successful, choose 1 of your leaders. Imperial leaders in the leader pool cannot be sent to oppose this leader's mission this round.

missions.name: Plan The Assault
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system that contains an Imperial ship. If successful, move ships (but not ground units) from the "Rebel Base" space to this system as if they were adjacent. Leaders in the "Rebel Base" space do not prevent this movement. Then resolve a combat in this system.

missions.name: Plant False Lead
missions.rulesText: Resolve in any system that contains an Imperial unit. Randomly take 4 of the Imperial player's probe cards. Place these cards on the top and/or bottom of the deck in any order without showing them to the Imperial player.

missions.name: Public Uprising
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any subjugated system. If successful, gain 1 circle and 2 triangle units (ships and/or ground units) in the system. Then resolve a combat.

missions.name: Rapid Mobilization
missions.rulesText: Resolve in the "Rebel Base" space. At the end of this phase, choose 1 of the following: If the Rebel base is not revealed, move up to 5 units from 1 system to the "Rebel Base" space, ignoring adjacency. Establish a new Rebel Base. If 2 leaders are assigned to this mission, draw 8 probe cards instead of 4.

missions.name: Rogue Squadron Raid
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any Imperial system. If successful, destroy up to 4 health worth of units of your choice on the build queue.

missions.name: Sabotage
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system. If successful, place a sabotage marker in this system. This marker prevents players from building units and deploying units in this system.

missions.name: Seek Yoda
missions.rulesText: Resolve in the Dagobah system. Attach the Master Yoda ring to this leader. Once per game round, when this leader is in the same system as a mission or combat, you may reroll 1 of your dice. If Luke Skywalker resolves this mission, also replace his leader with Luke Skywalker (Jedi).

missions.name: Stolen Plans
missions.rulesText: Attempt in any system that contains an Imperial unit. If successful, look at the top 4 cards of the objective deck. Place those cards on top of the deck in any order.

missions.name: Support Of Mon Calamari
missions.rulesText: Attempt in the Mon Calamari system. If successful, either gain 2 loyalty in this system or place 1 Mon Calamari Cruiser on space 3 of the build queue.

missions.name: Wookie Uprising
missions.rulesText: Attempt in the Kashyyyk system. If successful, gain 1 loyalty in this system and destroy up to 4 health worth of units of your choice in this system.
